After all why would you are forced to live with someone like him forever right? It just feels like a nightmare knowing that you will get married to that cruel bastard but yet all you can do is just accept the fate.*

You ended up waiting for him for a few minutes in front of the gate to your family luxurious mansion before Michael's car stopped in front of you.*
